# Research agenda: TITLE

Use the agenda for program sequencing and comparison ladders. Every hypothesis receives a durable
`hypothesis/H<NN>-<title>.md` record containing:

- question and mechanism;
- simplest credible baseline;
- observable variables and information cutoff;
- evaluation split and primary metric;
- rejection criterion;
- plausible alternative explanations; and
- result state: untested, rejected, revised, or advanced.

Exploratory findings become new registered hypotheses; they do not rewrite old ones.
